_about: Typical heat transfer coefficients, fouling resistances and wall materials for pre-sizing heat exchangers (proposal 0013, step 1; src/units/heat-exchange.js). Transcribed from the page images of the source below, value by value, in the units printed there; temperatures of Table A.1 in degrees C as printed. A range is [low, high]; a single bound has `bound`. Marks of Table A.1: '+' a little above the printed value, '-' a little below; the value is the printed number, the mark is kept. The person who reviews this file compares every value with the page named in its block.

source.citation: J. H. Lienhard V and J. H. Lienhard IV, A Heat Transfer Textbook, 6th edition, version 6.00 (19 April 2024), Phlogiston Press, Cambridge, Massachusetts
source.access: Free book: free to download from https://ahtt.mit.edu/ ("the authors grant you the right to download and print it for your personal use or for non-profit instructional use", title page verso); its numbers are taken, cited by table and page, not its text or figures (the maintainer, 2026-10-20)
